name: @newchobo/harness
description: Deterministic repository agent workflow harness and preset validator

scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" "schemas/**/*.json" "standard/**/*.{md,yaml}" "examples/**/*.{md,yaml}" "packages/**/*.{md,yaml,json,ts}" ".newchobo/**/*.{md,yaml,json}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "docs/**/*.md" CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml "tsconfig*.json" vitest.config.ts ".github/workflows/*.{yml,yaml}"
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" "schemas/**/*.json" "standard/**/*.{md,yaml}" "examples/**/*.{md,yaml}" "packages/**/*.{md,yaml,json,ts}" ".newchobo/**/*.{md,yaml,json}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "docs/**/*.md" CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml "tsconfig*.json" vitest.config.ts ".github/workflows/*.{yml,yaml}"
